subject.name: Colonialism and nationalism in India
subject.course_or_branch: BA in Socialogy Psychology Political Science

chapters.chapter_name: Approaches to the Study of Nationalism in India
content: Main perspectives on colonialism - Liberalism, Marxism & Post
colonialism, Approaches to studying nationalism in India
Nationalist, Imperialist, Marxist and Subaltern, Indian Perspectives
on Nationalism, Understanding Colonialism in a Multi-Cultural
Society

chapters.chapter_name: Impact of Colonial Rule in India
content: The Stages of Colonial Development, Constitutional developments
and the colonial state, Colonial Ideology of Civilizing mission
Utilitarians and Missionaries, Impact on agriculture, land relations
industry and ecology
Phases of Nationalist Movement - Liberal Constitutionalists
Swadeshi and the Radicals
Beginning of Constitutionalism in India
Gandhi and Mass Mobilisation - Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil
Disobedience Movement, and Quit India Movement, Socialist
Alternatives: Congress Socialists, Communists, Role of the Press
and Media

chapters.chapter_name: Role of Social Movements in Colonial India
content: Peasant Movements - Indigo Revolt, Champaran Satyagraha
Bardoli Satyagraha, Tebagha Movement, Tribal Movements - Birsa
Munda Revolt, Devi Movement, Naga Movement, Student
Participation in the Nationalist Struggle for Independence, The
Women’s Question: Participation in the National Movement and its
Impact
The Role of the Indian National Congress in India’s Struggle for
Independence, Communalism in Indian Politics , The Two-Nation
Theory and Negotiations over Partition
